tasks.title: Counter class
tasks.statement: Define a class Counter: a new counter has the attribute value equal to 0; the method inc() increases value by 1; the method reset() sets value back to 0. Print nothing: the checker will call your class itself.
tasks.hint: Set self.value = 0 in __init__; change self.value in the methods.

tasks.title: Rectangle
tasks.statement: Define a class Rectangle(w, h) with the methods area() for the area, perimeter() for the perimeter, and is_square(), which returns True if the sides are equal.
tasks.hint: Store self.w and self.h; use them in the methods.

tasks.title: A dog with a description
tasks.statement: Define a class Dog(name, age) with a method __str__ that returns «Собака Рекс, 5 лет» (the name and age are substituted in), and a method birthday() that increases the age by 1.

tasks.title: Bank account
tasks.statement: Define a class BankAccount(balance=0): an attribute balance; a method deposit(x) adds money to the account (x must be greater than 0, otherwise ValueError); a method withdraw(x) takes money out (x greater than 0 and not more than the balance, otherwise ValueError).
tasks.hint: At the start of each method check the condition and do raise ValueError(...), then change the balance.

tasks.title: Your own stack
tasks.statement: Define a class Stack with the methods push(x), pop() (removes and returns the top element), peek() (returns the top element without removing it), is_empty() and size(). The elements must be kept in a list inside the object.

tasks.title: Best student
tasks.statement: Define a class Student(name, grade) and a function best_student(students): it takes a list of Student objects and returns the NAME of the student with the highest grade (on a tie, the one who comes earlier in the list).
tasks.hint: Walk through the list and update the best one only for a strictly greater grade.

tasks.title: A team without a shared list
tasks.statement: Define a class Team: the method add(name) adds a member, and the method size() returns their number. Each team has its own list, so don't make it a class attribute.
tasks.hint: self.members = [] inside __init__, so that each instance has its own list.
